name: Non-Parametric Transfer Function Generation
aliases: Variable Kernel Density Estimation for TF Clustering
definition: A clustering method for the 2D histogram (conventional or abstracted) using variable kernel density estimation to group data based on neighborhood information.
summary: Non-Parametric Transfer Function Generation is a clustering method for 2D histograms that groups data by neighborhood using variable kernel density estimation to identify local maxima as volumetric feature clusters.
